title: Sort by height, chain transfer in Ladder
summary: Tell three box heights apart with two beams, remember the answer until the box reaches the chain transfer, and send it straight, right or left.
scope: Passing means your program behaved correctly in the simulator on this computer. It says nothing about a real machine, its timing or its safety.
objectives: Decide a route from a combination of two sensors.
Remember a decision while the next box is already passing the sensors.

stages.title: Objective
stages.body: In src/HeightSortChain.ld.json, latch what the two beams see while a box passes: 0.20 m breaks neither, 0.30 m only BeamLow, 0.40 m both. When the box has stood still at the blade for a second, send it straight on, or lift the module and move it right or left.
stages.checkpoint: Short boxes end in BinShort, medium in BinMedium, tall in BinTall, and Done lights after nine boxes.

stages.title: Predict
stages.body: Before running, fill a table of the two beams for the three heights, and say when the latch must be cleared: the next box passes the beams while this one is still on the module.
stages.checkpoint: A box is classified when it has stood still at the blade, and the latch is cleared at that moment, not when the box leaves.

stages.title: Edit
stages.body: Correct this starter omission, save it, then run: The starter has no rungs, so no belt moves and no box is sorted; run the belts after Start, classify each box from the two beams and send it straight, right or left.
stages.checkpoint: Check reports the scenario of this lesson as passed.

stages.title: Run
stages.body: Press Check. ZPLC runs your saved program against the scenario of this lesson, with the plant answering your outputs, and lists every assertion that failed. To watch the plant move, press Run (F5) and open the 3D view.
stages.checkpoint: The required scenario is named height-sorting-chain and contains {{assertions}} assertions.

stages.title: Observe
stages.body: Watch the 3D view: the module stays down for a short box; for the others it stops, rises, slides the box sideways and goes down again. Lift and run are never TRUE together.
stages.checkpoint: MoveRight is TRUE only for medium boxes and MoveLeft only for tall ones, and both only while Lift is TRUE.

stages.title: Reflect
stages.body: The grade sees the three bins and that no box was misrouted or dropped; it does not read your latch, so a wrong answer shows only as a misrouted box.
stages.checkpoint: What the assertions check is tested; nothing else is.

hints.text: Set SawLow and SawHigh with set coils whenever Low and High are TRUE, and decide the direction from them after the box has stood still for a second (a TON on AtBlade). Reset both latches right after with reset coils, in rungs that come later in the same scan.
One state per step: 1 wait for the box, 2 straight on, 3 lift and wait until Raised has held for T#300ms, 4 slide, 5 lower and wait for Lowered. Never run the module while Lift is TRUE.

faultCases: The starter has no rungs, so no belt moves and no box is sorted; run the belts after Start, classify each box from the two beams and send it straight, right or left.
